Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. India absolutely mauled Sri Lanka and will aim for more of the same in the coming games. The second ODI will be played on the 24th of August 2017 at 1430 local (0900 GMT) at the Pallekele International Cricket Stadium. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Virat Kohli says that Sri Lanka got off to a really good start and it did put them under pressure. Calls it a really good wicket to bat which is why they chose to chase since it is easy to play strokes under lights. Credits the bowlers for getting the breakthroughs. Lauds Dhawan's efforts and credits him for cashing in and making the chances count. Hopes that they keep Dhawan in the good zone as he can win them games single-handedly. Mentions that they have started planning for the World Cup in 2019 and are happy to take on challenges. Informs that there will be quite a few surprises in the coming games. On not playing Kuldeep Yadav, he responds by saying that Axar Patel gives a batting option as well and they were happy to play only one wrist spinner. Believes that it is always about the balance of the side.

Upul Tharanga says that once the Indians capitalized it became really difficult for them. Reckons that they were aiming for 300 while batting but to reach that someone needed to carry on and get a good score which didn't happen. Ends by saying that they will have to learn from their mistakes and be consistent with both the bat and the ball.

Man of the Match, Shikhar Dhawan says that things are going very well for him and he is just playing his natural game. Feels that his performances have given him the confidence to play freely. Mentions that he went in with positive intent and that worked in favour of him.

The hosts will be disappointed that they could not even fight. None of their bowlers looked threatening and their fielding too was below standard. Earlier in the day, it was the Indian spinners who choked the Lankans with some tight bowling after they got off to a great start. The visitors claimed 9 for 77 to push the hosts off the track and restricted them to a paltry total. A lot of soul-searching is the need of the hour for the Islanders if they want to stay alive in the series.

Nothing much to write really! India chased down the target of 217 with ages to spare and the only wicket that Sri Lanka managed was due to the fault (or bad luck) of the Indian opener, Rohit Sharma. Both Shikhar Dhawan and Virat Kohli had an extended nets session out in the middle as the bowlers for the hosts failed to create any pressure. Dhawan helped himself to a ton while the Indian skipper notched up yet another 50-plus score in a run chase.

FOUR! India win by 9 wickets with 127 balls to spare! Loops it around off, Dhawan comes down and just eases it through the mid off region for a boundary. India ease into a 1-0 lead in the 5-match ODI series.
Fuller on middle and leg, Dhawan wants to clip it through the leg side but gets a soft leading edge towards the bowler.
Short and outside off, punched through the point region for a single.
Short and outside off, punched hard to the extra cover fielder.
Shorter on middle, Dhawan pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller around off, Kohli just smashes it down the ground for a boundary. Nobody moved there. India need only 3 more!
Full toss on middle, Kohli clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Very full ball outside off, Kohli digs it out with a straight bat.
Shorter and down the leg side, Shikhar jams it down to fine leg for a single.
Another full toss outside off, Kohli eases it through covers for a single.
Full toss outside off, Kohli cannot put it away and finds the fielder at mid off.
Bowls it wide outside off, Kohli looks to drive but gets an inside edge past his stumps for a single. Just 11 needed now, even if India forfeit ten overs, they can sleep to a win.
Fuller on off, drilled to long off for a single.
Kohli comes forward and drives it through mid off for a single.

SIX! Shot of the match, by some distance! Sandakan bowls it around off, Kohli gets under it and just punches it over the head of the bowler for a maximum. He and Dhawan are having their own mini battle here.
FOUR! Fires it down the leg side, Virat does not miss out and sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Slammed! Fuller on middle and leg, Kohli gets under it and whips it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Shorter in length on middle and leg, Shikhar aims to pull but misses it. The keeper appeals but nothing from the umpire there. Even the bowler was not interested.
Follows Dhawan who is backing away. Shikhar manages to chop it into the off side.

FOUR! Smacked that, not at all on the floor! Short and outside off, Dhawan gets across and pulls it in the air over the square leg region for a boundary. This is now the highest ODI score for an Indian at this venue.
Long off drops back.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Dhawan stands tall and swings it over the mid-wicket region for a single. Mathews had to slide near the fence to stop that one.

DROPPED! Good length around middle and leg, Dhawan wants to put it out of Sri Lanka but top edges it. Tharanga gets under it at mid on. He runs back and looks to take but was never in control of it. Nothing, nothing working for the home side. Two runs taken.
Lasith Malinga is back into the attack!
Fuller and outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Dhawan wants to finish in style! Fuller and outside off, Shikhar comes down and clobbers it high and handsome over the long off fence for a maximum. Hit that with the wind there.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter in length outside off, Kohli goes back and punches it back to the bowler.
Drives it in the air just wide of the bowler for a single to long off.
FOUR! Mistimed for a boundary! Shorter in length, Dhawan goes back to punch but gets it off the inner half wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary. Everything is going in his favour here.
Lakshan Sandakan comes back on for a bowl.
Full and outside off, Kohli shapes to drive but does so off the inner half towards the mid-wicket region. India need 49 more in 26 overs.
Wide outside off, Kohli is happy to leave it through.
Fuller and outside off, drilled to long off for a single.
Now he reverse sweeps it towards the point region.
FOUR! Hit away! This time he gets it just over the head of the mid off fielder for a boundary. This is all too easy for the Indian opener.
Edged! Dhawan comes down to go big over the leg side but gets an edge towards the short third man fielder.
Shorter and outside off, Kohli punches it towards point.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and outside off, Kohli gets under it and slices it over the mid off fielder. The ball trickles into the ropes for a boundary.
Nudges it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Shorter in length on middle, Dhawan mistimes his pull towards mid-wicket. They take a single as Hasaranga misses his shy at the bowler's end. Replays show had he hit, Dhawan would have been out.
44th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli!

Fifty for the Indian skipper! He too is batting at a good rate but Dhawan has overshadowed him. Around middle, Kohli nudges it through the mid-wicket region for a single. He raises his bat to acknowledge the applause.
Fuller and outside off, Kohli drives it towards mid off.

FOUR! Fastest century for an Indian in an ODI against Sri Lanka in a run chase! Hasaranga drops it short and outside off, Shikhar goes back and dabs it towards the third man region. The fielder gives it a chase but fails to cut it off. That is also a century for Dhawan, his 11th in all! He celebrates it like he always does, with a beaming smile and arms spread wide like the Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan. He has really nailed the opening slot now. Just think about it. He wasn't in the initial Test squad, got a call for his selection when he was holidaying and has pounced onto the opportunity since then!
FOUR! Inches closer to the ton! Fuller and down the leg side, Dhawan accepts the gift and sweeps it through the backward square leg region for a boundary.
Flatter on middle, Shikhar comes down to go hard but can only pat it back to the bowler.
Shorter on middle, Dhawan makes room to cut but chops it towards the off side.
FOUR! Hit away! Fuller on middle, Dhawan comes down and drills it through the mid off region for a boundary. He is toying with the field here.
Floats it around off, Kohli pushes it through mid off for a single.
Clips it towards mid on and takes a quick single.
Shorter on middle, Kohli punches it towards mid-wicket from his crease.

DROPPED! Short and outside off, Dhawan wants to cut it. The ball flies off the edge wide of the keeper. Dickwella leaps to his left but cannot hold onto the catch. That was tough chance but can't do much now. A single taken.
Great stop! That's his only role in the side. Short and outside off, Dhawan cuts it hard but finds the point fielder. Kapugedera stops it.

FOUR! Sublime! Dhawan comes down and takes this on the full, gets it past the short extra cover fielder for a boundary.
Fuller on middle, turned through mid on for a single.

Dhawan heaves it towards mid on from the crease.
100-run stand between Dhawan and Kohli!
FOUR! Dhawan continues to flow! Flatter outside off, Dhawan fetches it and reverse sweeps it behind point for a boundary.
Dhawan prods forward and pushes it into covers for a run.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Fuller and outside off, pushed to wide mid off for a single.

FOUR! Bad ball and punished! Drops it short around leg, Dhawan goes back and pumps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Wanidu Hasaranga to bowl.
Shorter around middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for a single. India need 104 more in 33 overs.
Kohli goes back and punches it through mid-wicket for a single.

Time for Drinks! India are cruising towards victory banking on the fluent knocks of Dhawan and Kohli. Sri Lanka will need to pull off a surprise if they hope to hold a chance in the game.

Good length delivery outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.

Tossed up outside off, Shikhar lunges forward and defends it.

Wrong 'un around off, Virat camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.

SIX! Crazy batting! Short delivery into the batsman, Shikhar stands tall and goes for the pull. Gets a top edge on it and the ball flies over the fine leg fence for half a dozen. One bouncer for the over signals the umpire.

SIX! Fifty for Shikhar Dhawan! Shorter delivery in line of the stumps, Dhawan camps back and pulls it with power this time. Gets it over the mid-wicket boundary for a biggie. The southpaw will want to continue in the same way.

Kohli gets forward and uses his wrists to flick it beautifully through the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Fuller outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for a single.

Way wide outside off, Virat still reaches out for it and drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery into the batsman, Dhawan pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a single. 50-run stand between Dhawan and Kohli.
Fuller delivery around off, Kohli flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Lasith Malinga is back on!
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot towards the fielder at point.
Angles this one into the pads, clipped through square leg for a single.
Length delivery outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Length delivery around off, Kohli shuffles across and defends it towards mid on with soft hands for a quick single.
Short delivery outside off, Kohli stays undisturbed at his crease.
Two fielders go back, deep square leg and deep point in place.
FOUR! Sublime! Fuller delivery in line of the pads, Kohli gets into the act as well as he just lunges a bit forward and clips it elegantly through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Four fielders are now allowed outside the circle till the end of the 40th over.
FOUR! Nothing is going to change the end result! Even after changing the field, Dhawan manages to crunch this boundary through the backward point region.
Square leg comes in. Point is sent back.
FOUR! Dhawan is only dealing in boundaries! Back of a length delivery outside off, Shikhar hangs back and caresses his punch through the point region for a boundary.
Angling into the pads, Virat clips it towards the fielder at wide mid on for a single.
Virat gets forward and defends it.
FOUR! Woah, such timing! Length around off, Kohli shuffles across and wrists it beautifully through the wide mid on region for a boundary.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Kohli pushes it back to the bowler.
Thisara Perera comes on for a bowl.
Length delivery around off, punched towards extra cover.
Dabbed behind the backward point region for a single.
Angling into the batsman, clipped towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length delivery around off, Kohli clips it towards the fielder at mid on.
Good length delivery outside off, Kohli lets that through to the keeper.
Spills this into the pads, Dhawan clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Angelo Mathews is introduced into the attack. He will be bowling after a long break. Can he produce the breakthrough?
FOUR! Now that's a top shot! Short delivery outside off, Kohli stands tall and crashes that through the cover region to end the over on a high with a boundary.

Length delivery outside off, Kohli presses forward and punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Angling into the pads, clipped towards square leg for a single.

Slower delivery angling into the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
FOUR! Boom! There is no stopping this man! Short delivery in line of the stumps, Dhawan stays deep in his crease and pulls it past the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli guides it towards third man for a single.
Outside off, Kohli lets it through to the keeper.
Length delivery around off, Kohli checks his drive uppishly towards the mid on region.
Bangs this short to welcome Kohli! Virat manages to sway away from the line of the ball just in time.
Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
FOUR! Sheer timing! Length around off, Dhawan leans forward and punches it through the cover-point region for a lovely boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli camps back and punches it through the cover region to get off the mark. Gets three runs in the process.
Angling into the pads, Virat clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Outside off, Kohli shoulders his arms to it.
Kohli gets behind the line of the ball to defend it on the off side.
Virat Kohli comes out to bat.

OUT! What a way to get run out! Rohit stays behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards the cover region. He calls for a single, Kapugedera rushes towards the ball to his right and has a shy at the non-striker's end. A direct hit is scored and Rohit seems to have lost his bat in the process of completing the run. The players appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that the bat got stuck just before the crease and Sharma's front leg was in the air when the ball hit the stumps. A lazy effort from Rohit and he has no one else to blame. The replays also showed that Rohit didn't put his head down and run straight up, in fact he kept watching the ball in between which hampered his pace. The bat getting stuck was unfortunate though. Anyway, Sri Lanka have their first wicket!
The umpires have gone upstairs for a run out appeal against Rohit Sharma!
Low full toss in line of the stumps, Sharma manages to clip it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length around off, defended towards covers off the crease.
Sharma gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Fantastic fielding! Dhawan lunges forward and creams it towards covers. The fielder dives to his right and gets a hand to it and saves a certain boundary for his team. A single is taken.

Confusion all round! Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, Sharma plays a straight drive to it. Malinga fails to stop it as the ball goes through. Similarly, the mid on fielder also fails to stop it despite a dive and the batsmen think of a single. Finally the mid off fielder comes to the rescue as he stops it with his feet. Sharma is blinded there and both the batsmen are in the middle. They still manage to complete the single easily as the ball was a bit far from the fielder after the stop. Phew!
Dhawan tries to push in line. Gets an inside edge towards long leg for a brace.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Shikhar fancies his cut this time around but fails to make contact.
Good length delivery in line of the stumps, Dhawan stays in his crease and defends it on the off side.
Back of a length delivery angling away, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angles it outside off, Sharma stays deep and punches it towards point. Kapugedera flies to his right and makes a beautiful stop.
FOUR! Length delivery around off, Dhawan presses forward and punches it through the gap between covers for another elegant boundary. A costly over this for the Lankans! 9 runs from it.
Shikhar gets behind the line of the ball to defend it neatly.
FOUR! Great shot! Fuller delivery outside off, Dhawan cashes on the width and smacks that through the cover region for a boundary. There is no stopping these!
Slings this one into the batsman, Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball to defend it on the leg side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Well bowled Fernando! Back of a length delivery around off, Dhawan tries to defend in line of the stumps. Gets beaten by the away moment and he is lucky not to edge it.
Length delivery around off, Dhawan lunges half-forward to defend it on the off side. He wants a single but is sent back.
Full toss outside off, Dhawan this time drills it towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Crunched! Fuller delivery outside off to start with, Dhawan leans forward and smashes it aerially through the extra cover region for a boundary. He is in ominous form.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl from the other end with the second new ball, on his ODI debut.
Length delivery around off, Sharma stays back and punches it back to the bowler.

Hurls a good length delivery to start with, shaping away. Sharma gets behind the line of the ball and pushes it towards the fielder at covers. A lot will depend on Malinga today, who will want to make his 200th ODI special!
Welcome back for the chase! Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan come out to bat. Sri Lanka begin with Lasith Malinga! Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
